description: Change a store's Pickup Settings page: isEnabled (customers can book pickup; turning it on also shows the Pickup Monitor in the menu), leadTimeMinutes, maxDaysAhead, slotDurationMinutes, blackoutDates (YYYY-MM-DD, the full list), timeSlots (the full weekly schedule: day, store-local HH:mm start and end, optional maxOrders and isActive; a window keeps its identity by day, start and end) and locations (the full list: with an id it updates that location, without one it adds one, and any left out is removed). Omitted fields keep their current values; read them first with get_pickup_settings. Admin. Requires Write + pickup.execute; operator credentials only. Preview first, then repeat identical arguments with previewReceipt and idempotencyKey. In-app assistants get a confirm card.

blackoutDates.description: The complete list of store-local dates (YYYY-MM-DD) customers cannot book.

isEnabled.description: Whether customers can book pickup at this store.

leadTimeMinutes.description: Minutes between ordering and the earliest pickup (0 or more).

locations.description: The complete list of pickup locations.

fulfillmentStoreId.description: The store whose pickup queue receives orders for this location (a storeId from get_pickup_settings). Omit to leave the location unlinked; orders then route by the location's name.

id.description: Existing location id from get_pickup_settings; omit to add a location.

shopifyLocationId.description: The Shopify location id this location maps to (digits).

warehouseId.description: The warehouse this location picks from (GUID from list_warehouses).

maxDaysAhead.description: How many days ahead customers can book (1 or more).

slotDurationMinutes.description: Length of a pickup slot, in minutes.

store.description: Store id, code or name; optional when the company has one store.

timeSlots.description: The complete weekly schedule of pickup windows.

day.description: One weekday, sunday … saturday; add a window for each further day.

end.description: Store-local end time, HH:mm (24-hour); after start.

isActive.description: False keeps the window but stops offering it (default true).

maxOrders.description: Orders the window takes; omit or 0 for unlimited.

name: save_pickup_settings
title: Save Pickup Settings
